CONTENT-10.note: validateIdParams on posts (id, postId), comments (id), reports (id); communityId parsed with parseId (400 otherwise); non-string query values 400; unknown categories match nothing; offset capped at 1e6; NUL rejected in post/comment/report bodies; errors via sendInternalError.

CONTENT-11.note: ContentStorage.createPostWithCooldown: cooldown check + insert in one transaction under pg_advisory_xact_lock(7301, userId) using DB time.

CONTENT-16.note: postUpload fileFilter rejects with UploadTypeError -> 400 INVALID_TYPE instead of dropping the file.

CONTENT-17.note: mediaType is always derived from the verified MIME type; body field ignored.

UI-14.note: Duplicate open report by the same user on the same target -> 409 ALREADY_REPORTED ('You have already reported this content'); a new report is possible once the old one was handled.
